item: sources.outlet_id: the outlet as an integer, kept by three triggers (R177)

summary: Integer sources.outlet_id (lowest id of the domain) replaces the text outlet key in the four outlet gates; AFTER INSERT / UPDATE OF domain, id / AFTER DELETE triggers keep it right (delete trigger pins the rowid-reuse hazard), boot step + Alembic e6b2d8f0a4c3 add it additively, the J1 rebuild replays the triggers. Encrypted, alone: migration 42 ms at 7,000 sources, 8.1 s at 700,000; first-install write +0.19 s; read query 5.62 s vs 6.01 s text join at 2.34 M mentions (source_id only 5.20 s), 12.37 s equal to source_id only at 4.68 M. Larger stores inferred. A row the boot step has not reached (NULL outlet_id) overcounts outlets, the unsafe direction (R146): an always-on exact fallback measured +29 % on the 2.34 M window (encrypted), so each gate asks outlets_unhealed once per run and passes unhealed=, and a healed store reads the plain form. NOT covered, stated: INSERT OR REPLACE across domains (recursive_triggers is off; nothing in src/ writes that way, a scan test pins it; the next boot heals it). Figures are from 2026-10-17/18 and were not re-benched on the final head.
